 Today's Libra Tarot Card Reading Prediction, October 29, 2026: Increase clarity between right and wrong. You may continue searching for something special. You will fulfil your responsibilities. Avoid haste in seizing opportunities. Assess the situation properly. Pay more attention to your regular routine.
 Advertisement Libra Tarot Horoscope Prediction Today, October 29, 2026 By: Arunesh Kumar Sharma New Delhi , Oct 29, 2026 07:22 IST Last Updated Oct 29, 2026 07:22 IST Published by India Today Web Desk Oct 29, 2026 07:22 IST Libra
Eight of Cups 
Today is a day that advises you to move forward with a practical approach. Plan your actions wisely. Avoid a one-sided perspective when making decisions. You may continue to seek solutions to mental confusions. Stay alert when making choices. Do not be easily influenced by the surrounding environment. Personal matters will remain normal. You will receive support from others.
 advertisement ❮ ❯ Read Full Story Be patient in personal matters. Avoid getting involved in unnecessary issues. Emphasis will be on dignity and privacy. You will avoid sharing information. Increase clarity between right and wrong. You may continue searching for something special. You will fulfil your responsibilities. Avoid rushing to seize opportunities. Assess the situation properly. Pay more attention to your regular routine.
 Health: Pay attention to your diet. Health-related issues may arise. Increase discipline.
 Financial situation: Keep your arrangements balanced. Policies and rules will be maintained. The profit situation will remain average.
